events.message: Mirai Dropper deployed. Link it back to C2 with a tunnel.  (Ctrl+Z to undo)
Now click any node to link toward — the C2, a Relay/Market, or another structure (data flows on to C2).
Mirai Dropper selected. (Delete or Dismantle to remove)

controls.tooltip:
Mirai Dropper
The Mirai botnet: default-password cameras and routers conscripted by the thousand. Each pwned device donates Cycles.
Cost: 10 Cycles

Poisoned Package
A typosquatted npm package quietly pulled into a thousand CI builds. A supply-chain compromise — big Cycles.
Cost: 40 Cycles, 10 Intel, 40 Cash

Cloud Cryptojacker
Stolen cloud keys spin up racks of instances on someone else's bill. Heavy Cycles.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 10 Intel, 60 Cash

Phishing Kit
An Emotet-style mail lure sprayed across an office. Sweeps Intel from inboxes in range.
Cost: 12 Cycles

Scraper Botnet
Credential-stuffing bots grinding leaked dumps against logins across the feeds. Sweeps Intel in range.
Cost: 15 Cycles

Magecart Skimmer
A few lines of JavaScript on a checkout page. Skims card data — pays out in Crypto.
Cost: 30 Cycles, 20 Intel, 30 Cash
